svg.title: S2 — Query answered from the local read model (US107; US108 and US211 likewise)

g.text: S2 — Query answered from the local read model (US107; US108 and US211 likewise)
Unknown IATA → 404 (not in the read model). Invalid IATA → 400.
No X-Partial-Response: every replica holds every airport.
The value can be milliseconds old (eventual consistency); the owner reads its own writes at once.
